author: @theo (Theo Browne)
title: T3 Code Now Supports Claude (Claude Code CLI Integration)

discoveries.name: T3 Code
discoveries.description: Minimal web GUI for coding agents — supports Codex and Claude Code CLI. Desktop app with 1,070 commits, 25 releases, 932 forks. Multi-harness frontend pattern.

key_insight: T3 Code represents the emerging 'GUI wrapper over agent CLI' pattern — same category as cmux, manaflow, and Cowork clones. Theo's massive reach (393K views) accelerates Claude Code adoption among TypeScript/Next.js developers.
